stories.t: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
stories.s: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.

stories.tz: 治疗克拉科夫枪击案嫌疑的医生：“我把所有这些人都视作受害者”

stories.t: The world's largest telecoms firm is on trial and the outcome has global implications
stories.s: Huawei, the world's biggest telecommunications company, is on trial in New York, accused of stealing American technology and evading US sanctions.
stories.tz: 全球最大电信公司正接受审判，裁决结果具全球影响
stories.sz: 全球最大电信公司华为在纽约受审，被控窃取美国技术并规避美国制裁。

stories.t: Trying to find true owners, Paris' Musee D'Orsay exhibits art looted by Nazis
stories.s: A new permanent exhibition at Paris' Musee d'Orsay showcases works of art suspected to have been looted by Nazis during the Second World War in France. Experts are trying to find the true owners or their descendants.
stories.tz: 巴黎奥赛博物馆展出纳粹掠夺艺术品，旨在寻觅真正主人

stories.t: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes

stories.t: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

stories.t: South Africa elections: ANC marks its worst-ever performance

stories.t: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
